prompt:
Original instrumental underscore exclusively for HOS 009 The Falling Moon, the story of Newton discovering that an apple and the Moon obey one pull. Period-coloured chamber sound, warm low bowed strings, soft viol drone, sparse plucked strings; leave generous space for British narration. Wonder in the moonlit fields and the solitary Woolsthorpe garden, then quiet intellectual delight as a cannon trajectory becomes an orbit and a careful sum becomes proof.
Pace: 60-72 BPM; wonder is spacious and sustained, teach has a gentle 68-72 BPM harpsichord arpeggio with no drum beat.
NOT any earlier HOS or Orbit bed, jupiter-music.mp3, generic cosmic shimmer/piano space-documentary music, a borrowed melody, heroic trailer brass, horror, plague melodrama, loud risers, vocals, lyrics, pop drums, comedy stings or EDM. Do not imitate a named composer or recording.

cues.direction: Moon question and apple/plague-year story: warm viol drone, sparse plucks, curious rather than ominous.
Cannon and Moon test: light harpsichord arpeggio, soft low strings. At part 5 thin the pulse to a warm sense of discovery; no silent break.

Current guard counts prompt characters, not music duration: not sufficient proof. Unknown price or billing mode means no POST; scope/guard correction goes to Chief, no purchase. Hold one recorder lock across preflight and the two requests; no automatic retries. Read balance after each request.
